purpose: Define how MathBridge assembles one teacher-facing concept card from curriculum, progression, representation, teaching, diagnostic and evidence records.
resolution_order: Load concept_intelligence_manifest.json and locate the concept profile in the listed profile files.
Resolve curriculum placement and progression for CN plus the selected comparison system.
Apply grade/stage filters without forcing same-numbered-grade equivalence.
Resolve canonical representations from both representation catalogs.
Resolve misconceptions relevant to the concept.
Resolve diagnostic questions that target those misconceptions.
Resolve source IDs and source metadata for every factual claim.
Assemble teacher-facing sections after evidence/status checks.

teacher_facing_sections.rule: Show curriculum expectation or placement. Do not present inferred classroom practice as curriculum.
State system-specific use only when evidence supports it. Otherwise present the representation as an option.
Recommend moves because they fit the concept and evidence. Do not describe them as national teaching traits without evidence.
Keep pedagogical rationale separate from curriculum requirements.
Do not attribute misconceptions to nationality or curriculum without evidence.
A wrong answer is a signal to probe, not a diagnosis. Include a follow-up explanation or representation prompt.
Give one practical adaptation that fits the Chinese curriculum context. Do not frame another system as inherently better.
Show the smallest set of sources needed to support the claims, with locators where available.

status_gates.verified: May be shown as a factual curriculum or source claim.
status_gates.partially_verified: Show only with a qualification explaining what remains unverified.
status_gates.research_required: Do not show as established fact.
status_gates.current_specifics_pending: May describe the general function, but not current grade-specific PEP use.
status_gates.grade_placement_pending: Do not infer an exact Chinese grade from stage-level or legacy evidence.
status_gates.joined_curriculum_mapping_required: The profile links teaching resources, but curriculum placement is not yet mapped.
status_gates.joined_diagnostic_required: The profile links teaching resources, but diagnostic content is not yet complete.

china_rules: Use the 2022 MOE mathematics standard for national curriculum requirements.
Use current PEP 12th-series evidence for exact textbook sequencing only when the relevant volume or locator has been verified.
Never silently substitute a legacy PEP sequence for the current edition.
If exact current grade placement is unknown, show the verified learning stage and mark textbook sequencing as pending.
england_rules: Label the jurisdiction England when using the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Separate statutory programme-of-study requirements from DfE or NCETM teaching guidance.
us_rules: Label Common Core as the comparison baseline, not the single US curriculum.
State-specific frameworks such as California or Texas may be layered separately when requested.
Do not infer that a Common Core representation requirement dictates one classroom method.
diagnostic_rules: Require at least two pieces of evidence before recording a likely misconception.
Distinguish conceptual misunderstanding, procedural weakness, fluency, representation difficulty and language difficulty.
For bilingual pupils, use a language-light or Chinese-language re-probe when wording may be the barrier.
After a targeted response, recheck with a similar problem using different surface details.
copy_rules: Use short headings and plain explanations.
State what the teacher or pupil should do.
Avoid marketing language, slogans, hype, promotional claims and AI-style filler.
Prefer specific evidence labels such as Verified, Partially verified, and Research required.

assembly_output_schema.context: CN grade/stage plus selected comparison jurisdiction/year/grade
assembly_output_schema.representations: Selected representation records with evidence status
assembly_output_schema.diagnostic: Diagnostic prompts and interpretation guidance when available
assembly_output_schema.classroom_bridge: Practical adaptation grounded in the resolved records
assembly_output_schema.sources: Deduplicated evidence records with locators and status

integrity_checks_before_render: Every concept ID resolves to exactly one profile.
Every representation and teaching-move ID resolves through the canonical registry.
Every non-empty misconception and diagnostic-question ID resolves.
Every factual system-specific statement has a source or an explicit pending/research status.
No grade equivalence is inferred merely because grade/year numbers match.
No legacy PEP record is selected as current by default.
